description: The closed set of membership roles inside an IDauto professional organisation. Adopted verbatim by the Mythos OS platform organisation-role contract.

compatibility.value_order: declaration order of the SQL CHECK; non-normative — comparisons are set equality
compatibility.additive: new value -> same major file, revision + 1
compatibility.deprecation: value stays present with status 'deprecated' for >= 1 major version
compatibility.breaking: removal, rename, or semantic change -> new file org-role.v2.json; v1 retained with status 'superseded'

values.description: Full control of the organisation's membership and subscription within IDauto. Not a Mythos platform-wide role — scoped to this organisation only.
Manages the organisation's members and settings within IDauto, without the owner's exclusive standing.
Standard professional-subscriber access to IDauto on behalf of the organisation.
View-only professional access; cannot submit or annotate on the organisation's behalf.
